summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed(speed) method that scales with filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render path that returns speed text when the total is unknown and show_speed is on. track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total; the total stays None. CHANGELOG has the Unreleased/Added line. In tests, the two ValueError assertions were removed and test_task_progress_column_speed was added. Not run: tests, mypy, and black, because the instructions said not to execute repository code. Nothing was committed.
